description: Of frontend development, turning designs into fast and accessible Vue interfaces, from small business websites to large dashboards.
content: Most of my days are spent between Vue components and SCSS files. I started with plain jQuery sites for local businesses and slowly moved to component based apps, design systems and the occasional animation that nobody asked for but everybody liked.
highlights: Built and maintained a shared component library used by four product teams
Cut the bundle size of a large dashboard by almost 40% with lazy loaded routes
Mentored two junior developers through their first production releases

description: Of backend work with Node, writing the REST APIs, websockets and scheduled jobs that keep my frontends running.
content: Every frontend needs something to talk to. I write small and boring Node services that just work: REST APIs, a few websockets, scheduled jobs and the glue code that keeps everything in sync.
highlights: Designed the REST API behind a booking platform with around 20k monthly users
Moved a legacy PHP backend to Node without any downtime
Automated deploys and database backups for all personal projects

description: Of desktop apps with Electron for Windows and MacOS, with tray icons, native menus, signed builds and auto updates.
content: At some point the browser wasn't enough, so I started packing web apps into desktop ones. Calendars, photo sync tools and a few internal utilities later, I know way more about auto updaters and native menus than I ever planned to.
highlights: Shipped a cross platform calendar app for Windows and MacOS
Wrote a background sync service between Android phones and Windows
Set up signed builds and auto updates for three different apps
